name: a-grant-is-for-what-it-was-granted-for
description: SPEC.md 4.9: a remembered grant is scoped to the tool AND the scope, exactly. A tool that names no scope (no ScopeOf - the shape of every MCP tool) leaves nothing to match exactly, so nothing is remembered and every act of it is its own approval question; an identical repeat is already replayed by run-once before approval is reached. Here the authority approves ten dollars and denies ten thousand: exactly one transfer runs, and it is the ten-dollar one - toolInput pins WHICH, so an implementation that granted the second act on the first act's approval fails, and so does one that denied both.
